surface.$description: Backgrounds, from sunken to overlay. Lighter surfaces sit closer to the user in the dark theme.

sunken.$description: Recessed areas behind the base surface: wells, map letterboxing, input backgrounds on raised panels.

base.$description: App background on ops screens. The canvas behind panels, tables, and the map.

raised.$description: Panels, cards, table headers, and docked panes that sit on the base surface.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, dialogs, and toasts that float above other content.

inverse.$description: Tooltips and other small callouts that invert the theme. Pair with text.inverse.

text.$description: Text colors. Primary and secondary meet 4.5:1 on every surface.

primary.$description: Default text and icons. Use for content the operator must read.

secondary.$description: Supporting text: labels, metadata, timestamps, units, and placeholder text.

disabled.$description: Text of disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast minimums (WCAG 1.4.3); never use it for content that must be read.

border.$description: Borders and dividers. Ops UIs lean on borders more than shadows.

subtle.$description: Decorative dividers and table gridlines. Below 3:1 by design; never the only boundary of a control.

default.$description: Control boundaries: inputs, buttons, checkboxes, and panel outlines. Meets 3:1 against every surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

strong.$description: Emphasized boundaries: selected cards, active panes, and high-contrast outlines.

interactive.$description: Colors for things the operator can act on.

fill.$description: Primary action background, such as the main button in a dialog.

on-fill.$description: Text and icons on interactive.fill and its hover and pressed states.

text.$description: Links and quiet or ghost button labels. Meets 4.5:1 on every surface.

hover.$description: Background of hovered rows, list items, and menu items.

selected.$description: Background of selected rows, list items, and tabs. Text on it uses text.primary.

ring.$description: Focus ring color. Meets 3:1 against every surface and selected background it can appear next to.

status.$description: Six-level status system following the Astro color-temperature model: critical, serious, caution, normal, standby, off. Always pair a status color with a status symbol shape or text; never use color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

critical.$description: Critical: a condition that needs immediate action, such as lost link or an active threat. Red is reserved for this level; never use it decoratively or for ordinary errors.

fill.$description: Critical status fill for symbols, chips, and badges. In the light theme pair it with the border token; the fill alone can fall below 3:1 on light surfaces.

border.$description: Critical status border. Meets 3:1 against surfaces in every theme.

on.$description: Text and icons placed on the critical status fill.

serious.$description: Serious: an error or degraded condition that needs attention soon.

fill.$description: Serious status fill for symbols, chips, and badges. In the light theme pair it with the border token; the fill alone can fall below 3:1 on light surfaces.

border.$description: Serious status border. Meets 3:1 against surfaces in every theme.

on.$description: Text and icons placed on the serious status fill.

caution.$description: Caution: an unstable or unusual condition worth watching.

fill.$description: Caution status fill for symbols, chips, and badges. In the light theme pair it with the border token; the fill alone can fall below 3:1 on light surfaces.

border.$description: Caution status border. Meets 3:1 against surfaces in every theme.

on.$description: Text and icons placed on the caution status fill.

fill.$description: Normal status fill for symbols, chips, and badges. In the light theme pair it with the border token; the fill alone can fall below 3:1 on light surfaces.

border.$description: Normal status border. Meets 3:1 against surfaces in every theme.

on.$description: Text and icons placed on the normal status fill.

standby.$description: Standby: ready, available, or enabled but not active.

fill.$description: Standby status fill for symbols, chips, and badges. In the light theme pair it with the border token; the fill alone can fall below 3:1 on light surfaces.

border.$description: Standby status border. Meets 3:1 against surfaces in every theme.

on.$description: Text and icons placed on the standby status fill.

fill.$description: Off status fill for symbols, chips, and badges. In the light theme pair it with the border token; the fill alone can fall below 3:1 on light surfaces.

border.$description: Off status border. Meets 3:1 against surfaces in every theme.

on.$description: Text and icons placed on the off status fill.

1.$description: Categorical series 1. Assign series in order.

2.$description: Categorical series 2. Assign series in order.

3.$description: Categorical series 3. Assign series in order.

4.$description: Categorical series 4. Assign series in order.

5.$description: Categorical series 5. Assign series in order.

6.$description: Categorical series 6. Assign series in order.

categorical.$description: Categorical palette for chart series and map layers. Meets 3:1 against surface.base and surface.raised. Do not use it to signal status.

sequential.$description: Sequential scale for heatmaps and density layers, from lowest (1) to highest (7) value. Higher values contrast more with the surface in every theme.
